Hi Talia,

It is not possible to say what might be going on without actually=20
looking at the data or even knowing what is the covariate you are using,=20
but I would agree that such different results with and without covariate=20
are very suspicious.

Do you want to provide me further details off the list (reply to my=20
e-mail only), maybe sending me your distance project, and we can then=20
report back if there is anything useful there for others?

Cheers

T.
